title: Add Cursor Maker to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Cursor Maker](https://hk.1r.gs) to image
- Cursor Maker (光标工坊) is an AI-powered Windows cursor generator. Type a one-line description (e.g. "glowing blue crystal arrow") and it generates a custom cursor design using the Pollinations image API 

Fixes #13598

gist.headline: Pointers grow on trees
gist.blurb: Cursor Maker joined the garden. Describe a cursor in one line, and Pollinations image generation helps turn it into a tiny piece of desktop personality.
gist.summary: Added Cursor Maker (光标工坊), an AI-powered Windows cursor generator that uses the Pollinations image API to create custom cursor designs from one-line prompts.
gist.impact: People can now discover Cursor Maker in the app directory and generate Windows cursor artwork from ideas like “glowing blue crystal arrow.”
gist.visual_concept: Depict Cursor Maker as a cozy desktop craft station: a large pixel cursor arrow is being painted into a magical custom design on a CRT monitor. Polli, wearing a tiny maker apron and holding a paintbrush, adds detail to the cursor while small code-plants and flowers grow around the workstation; the cursor represents turning a short description into usable Windows cursor art.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, black oval eyes, pink rectangular blush cheeks, light blue rounded wings, and a tiny maker apron, carefully painting a large custom pixel cursor arrow on a glowing CRT monitor; the cursor shifts from a simple arrow into a crystal-and-pastel design while code-plants sprout from flower pots nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel mint-lavender-peach gradient background, warm lighting, chunky retro sprites, subtle scanlines, retro gaming vibes; pixel-font text: “CURSOR MAKER”. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
